name: Thompson Chicago
positioning: Boutique Gold Coast hotel (officially Thompson Chicago, by Hyatt) with mid-century modern rooms, a flagship steak and seafood restaurant, and the lake a short stroll away
best_for: Travelers who want a Gold Coast base near Oak Street, the Magnificent Mile and Oak Street Beach
Groups wanting a bi-level suite with a terrace

facts.text: The hotel is at 21 East Bellevue Place on Chicago's Gold Coast, a short stroll from Oak Street's boutiques, the Magnificent Mile and Oak Street Beach on Lake Michigan.
Rooms and suites have 400-thread-count Sferra linens, rainfall showers, mid-century modern furnishings and artwork.
Select rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Lake Michigan, tree-lined streets and the Magnificent Mile.
The Thompson Suite has in-room fitness amenities, including a Peloton bike and free weights.
Tavern on Rush is the hotel's flagship restaurant and bar, serving steak and seafood.
Tavern on Rush serves brunch on Saturdays and Sundays.
The fitness center has Peloton bikes, rowing machines, and cardio and strength equipment, and is available to guests around the clock.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel as sleek with organic accents that hint at a Prairie School architectural homage.
Thompson Chicago is dog-friendly, though dogs cannot be left unattended in guest rooms.
The nearest CTA station is Chicago/State on the Red Line.
Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance around the clock.

highlights.text: The two-story Penthouse Suites feature a billiards table and an outdoor terrace.
The fourth-floor Froines Room lounge has a floor-to-ceiling half-moon window overlooking Bellevue Street.
Tavern on Rush has multi-level seating, private dining, a bar and an outdoor patio on Rush Street.
The Skyline Loft Suite with Terrace is bi-level, with a spiral staircase, a dining table for four and a private balcony terrace.

considerations.text: A daily destination fee applies to each room; it covers perks such as a discount at the 360 Chicago Observation Deck and daily bottled water.
Lake views come only with select rooms and suites; others look over the city.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the upscale Gold Coast location.
